posts.caption: Made one decent flat white. At this rate, the machine pays for itself in 2041.
posts.translationZh: 終於做出一杯像樣的馥芮白。照這速度，咖啡機大概 2041 年回本。
posts.scene: Zoe in the same home kitchen, visibly pleased but amused, holding her first decent flat white beside the espresso machine; a wiped-clean counter still has one folded towel and milk jug from yesterday's spill.
posts.imageAlt: Zoe smiling at her first successful homemade flat white beside the espresso machine in her kitchen.

posts.caption: Found one die under the sofa. We are not reopening the investigation.
posts.translationZh: 在沙發底下找到一顆骰子。我們決定不重啟調查。
posts.scene: Bella kneeling beside the same living-room sofa the morning after game night, laughing as she holds up a stray die; the picnic blanket is folded nearby and a few game pieces remain on the coffee table.
posts.imageAlt: Bella laughing as she finds a stray die under her sofa after the previous night's board game.

posts.caption: Went back to the bakery for research. Very serious research. I ordered two.
posts.translationZh: 回那家麵包店做研究。非常嚴謹的研究。我點了兩個。
posts.scene: Hugo back at the tiny bakery from day one, comparing two flaky croissants at the small table with an espresso, taking a close look at the layers after his failed home batch.
posts.imageAlt: Hugo comparing two flaky croissants at the tiny bakery table with an espresso.

posts.caption: Woke up and changed one keycap. Apparently I learned nothing.
posts.translationZh: 醒來後又換了一顆鍵帽。看來我什麼都沒學到。
posts.scene: Theo at the same desk in morning light, replacing exactly one keycap on the finished compact keyboard; last night's tools are mostly packed away and the analog clock is visible.
posts.imageAlt: Theo changing one keycap on his finished compact keyboard the morning after the late-night rebuild.

posts.caption: The new leaf opened a little more overnight. Yes, I checked before making tea.
posts.translationZh: 新葉子一夜之間又展開了一點。對，我泡茶前就先去看它了。
posts.scene: Yuna in soft morning light at the same windowsill, leaning close to inspect the newly unfurling leaf before her familiar tea mug has been filled; the same plant and window setting remain.
posts.imageAlt: Yuna checking the newly unfurling leaf on her windowsill plant before making her morning tea.
